generic_fix_tank_organization = {
	allowed = { NOT = { original_tag = AAA } }
	equipment_type = { armor }
	research_categories = { armor_cat }
	initial_trait = { name = fix_initial equipment_bonus = { reliability = 0.05 } }
	trait = { token = fix_t1 name = fix_t1 position = { x = 0 y = 0 } equipment_bonus = { breakthrough = 0.05 } }
	trait = { token = fix_t2 any_parent = { fix_t1 } production_bonus = { production_cost_factor = -0.05 } }
	trait = { token = fix_t3 any_parent = { fix_t1 } mutually_exclusive = { fix_t2 }
		organization_modifier = { military_industrial_organization_funds_gain = 0.1 } }
}

AAA_fix_works_organization = {
	include = generic_fix_tank_organization
	allowed = { original_tag = AAA }
	available = { FROM = { has_completed_focus = AAA_army_focus } }
	remove_trait = { fix_t3 }
	override_trait = { token = fix_t2 production_bonus = { production_cost_factor = -0.10 } }
	add_trait = { token = AAA_special any_parent = { fix_t2 } equipment_bonus = { hard_attack = 0.1 } }
}

BBB_fix_organization = {
	include = generic_fix_tank_organization
	allowed = { tag = BBB }
}

AAA_scripted_organization = {
	include = generic_fix_tank_organization
	allowed = { aaa_fix_trigger = yes }
	visible = { FROM = { has_dlc = "Fixture DLC" } }
}

DEBUG_fix_organization = {
	include = generic_fix_tank_organization
	allowed = { is_debug = yes }
}
